title: Shipped output names Intent's own issue numbers, and the project-state scan has no pattern for an issue id
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-23 while cutting 0535 v4, and ruled on by vc the same day.

**What happens.** AT-00.8 and AC-00.9 hold that Intent's own project-management state never reaches output. The test that enforces them, intent-cli's `no_pm_state_in_output`, scans shipped string literals for thread, work-package, criterion and decision ids, and has no pattern for an issue id. So a remedy or a finding can send a user in any estate to one of Intent's own issue numbers, and the scan stays green. dc counted eight shipped literals that name an issue at HEAD. Examples found by grep:
- `doctor.rs`: "the index-side probe is dirty while fts5's own check passes -- the shape of issue 0442";
- `contract.rs`: "no verb writes the exemption, so the refusal never names it (issue 0400)";
- a long literal in `ingest.rs` that names issues 0453 and 0447;
- 0532's own doctor note, "rendered before issue 0532, ...", which dc's 0539 bank rewords.

0535 v4 took the same form out of its new remedy before it shipped.

**What the fix has to do.**
- The scan recognises an issue id in a shipped literal, with the same tolerance it already gives comments.
- Each literal it then finds says the cause in words, not a pointer into Intent's own ledger.
- A literal that is deliberately about Intent's own history, if any is, is declared as an exception with its reason, the way the scan's other exceptions are.

**Scope.** This predates 3.2.1 except for 0532's note, which the 0539 bank fixes. Whether the rest goes into 3.2.1 waits on hv's ruling on a cutoff for findings reported after the stacked judging run started; vc recommends 3.2.2.

**Ruled (vc under hv's pen, 2026-09-23, under hv's word for this cut: "everything we can into 3.2.1 unless there's some clear reason not to"): fixed in 3.2.1, in three parts.** (1) The shipped literals. (2) The schema faces `intent schema` prints. (3) The installed payload, with comments and prose only, plus the text of one line the pre-commit gate prints. vc's scope rulings: `ISSUE:0000` stays admitted, because it is the manifest's own address; build-support joins the literal walk; literals inside `#[cfg(test)]` are out.

**THE FIX.**

- The scan: `pm_identifiers` counts `issue`, `Issue`, `issues` or `Issues` followed by exactly four digits, with the scan's existing left and right boundaries, so `ISSUE:0000`, five digits and three digits are not counted. The literal arm also walks `native/rust/build-support`, whose `cargo:warning` lines reach whoever builds from source. The schema-face arm and AT-00.17's payload arm count the class through the same matcher, so nothing is declared unenforced.
- The literals: doctor's orphans-only index finding now says that fts5's own check does not look for an indexed document with no content row. The unreadable-index remedy on opening the store drops its pointer. The two build warnings each say their cause.
- The faces: two `edited_at` field descriptions in `model.rs` drop their pointer, and `schema/` is re-blessed.
- The payload: 43 citations across 16 installed files (hooks, Claude scripts, skills, rules, the tca scripts and `intent_claude_cwi`) now say their cause in words. No executable line changed except the text of the pre-commit gate's resolver message.

**RED FIRST.** On base d5709e0d0, the literal, schema-face and payload arms were each red, naming every site above.

**THE JUDGING.** dc's stacked run over 0542, 0546 and 0547, from 22:14:37Z to 22:29:43Z by date -u. Base 8442b234c had cargo 3072 passed and 0 failed, and bats 743 of 743. The stack had bats 747 of 747; fmt, both clippy lines, doc, the rlib grep with its control, and app-test all passed. The one stack-only red was 0542's own `an_unreadable_index_table_is_named_and_the_canon_is_not_blamed`, which asserted the removed pointer. v2 drops that clause, and intentsvcs's whole suite is green on the v2 stack. vc judged it passing.

**LANDED (dc, 2026-09-23, on vc's word).** At aecd492b3 on 46589de2c, at the judged patch-id 4490803b9. The bank was refs/bank/dc/0542/v2 (blob 9946715be). `lib/templates` and `intent/plugins` are read live, so those parts are deployed on landing. The Rust parts reach a machine at the next `bin/devbin build all`.
